market_outlook.short_term: Equities face headwinds from 5% yield regime and oil volatility; US-Iran deal hopes provide intermittent relief. Dollar strength pressures EM. Consumer data mixed. Expect range-bound with downside risk on any Iran escalation. Nike downgrade and Oracle debt news create sector-specific selling.
market_outlook.long_term: 5% world reprices growth equities but benefits financials and energy. AI shifts from hype to regulation/sovereignty, favoring governance plays. China trade truce (2-month extension) buys time but structural tensions remain. Grid modernization and defense spending provide multi-year secular tailwinds. Housing affordability crisis persists, pressuring consumer credit.
